question: Does a higher-quality research-source quorum materially improve 60d hit rate without changing downstream stock-selection rules?

quorumDefinition.industryState: At least one cutoff-valid physical-industry, official, specialist, or high-quality news source establishing the state change.
quorumDefinition.companyPrimary: At least one cutoff-valid issuer filing/IR source establishing direct exposure or realized company economics.
quorumDefinition.independentResearch: At least one cutoff-valid independent sell-side/research report with forward earnings, valuation, expectation, or cross-sectional analysis.
quorumDefinition.independence: Transport mirrors do not count as independent origins; original broker/research house identity is used.
quorumDefinition.note: Quorum is an evidence-quality feature only. It does not waive timing, absorption, valuation, or causal gates.
